# k8s node debug image

Requirements:
* `/host` to be mounted
* host Access
```yaml
spec:
  hostIPC: true
  hostNetwork: true
  hostPID: true
  containers:
  - # [...]
    securityContext:
      allowPrivilegeEscalation: true
      privileged: true
```

Settings (env)
* `HOST_COMMANDS` overwrite default host commands (nsenter --target 1 --mount "${cmd}" "$@")
* `HOST_COMMANDS_ADD` extra host commands to be added next to the default/`HOST_COMMANDS`
* `COMPLETION_COMMANDS_ADD` commands where completion can be generated by calling `${cmd} completion [bash|zsh]`
* `HOST_PATH` overwrite PATH which is used for searching for host commands, also used as PATH when calling `hostcmd [...]`

## k3s

* expects it to be installed in /opt/bin or in any HOST_PATH dir
* also mount `/var/lib/rancher` to support kubectl command besides others
